caseNameFull: Webster, Attorney General of Missouri v. Reproductive Health Services

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 488 U. S. 1003.] Motions of James Joseph Lynch, Jr., and National Legal Foundation for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Motion of Legal Defense for Unborn Children for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae denied. Motion of Alan Ernest for leave to represent children unborn and born alive denied.
